title: The Pop Quiz Bluff
premise: In a bright school classroom, strict math teacher ms-pratt springs a surprise pop quiz on her class. Student leo has not studied. His only prep was one video he watched at 2x speed. His deskmate ava whispers the real answer, x = 4, but Leo ignores her and loudly answers seven, bragging that math is a feeling and confidence always wins. At the board he shows his work with nonsense: carry the vibes, divide by confidence, square the heart. ms-pratt says he is wrong, but it is the best bluff she has
